# Changelog

## 0.3.0

* Modernize packaging, tooling, CI, and Python support for Python 3.11–3.14.
* Scope IDs generated by `set_request_id()` to the decorated call and restore the previous context afterwards.
* Preserve existing logging record-factory fields when enabling request-ID enrichment.
